provenance.procedure: GET /search/movie?query=A+Held+Movie&page=1 with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 contract (ADR-0026) because CI has no token and none may be committed. Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb search-movie-held.
provenance.note: Synthesised: the held-film enrich search. TMDB ranks a same-named 1999 decoy FIRST (id 701) and the 2016 film the library holds second (id 700), to prove the client validates a hit's year against the Work's rather than trusting rank; the third hit shares no title words and proves the overlap floor. The client reads only id, title/original_title and release_date here — the overview, artwork and ids come from the detail call.
